author: Dennis
name: Meows plugin
description: A Meows plugin: project, plugin class, view, view model and string catalogues, ready to build and drop into a plugins folder.

Category.description: Heading this plugin appears under on the Plugins tab. The built-in headings are keys (group.everyday, group.disk, group.bot) and are translated; anything else is shown as written.

pluginId.description: The id, taken from the project name in lower case. Change it before anyone installs the plugin: it is the settings key, and moving it later orphans stored settings.
